promise_or_control_point: deposits loans payments markets wealth and capital access inside one bank
immediate_payer_or_funder: depositors borrowers merchants institutional clients and capital-market users
main_burden_carrier: deposit cost credit losses regulation capital technology liquidity and market cyclicality
current_evidence: FY2025 revenue 182.447B; net income 57.048B; assets 4.4249T; deposits 2.5593T; ROTCE 20%; Q1/Q2 2026 Markets and Payments strength
qoe_or_shenanigans_test: separate deposits loans NIM funding cost delinquencies charge-offs reserves capital and recurring versus episodic market income
owner_cash_denominator: earnings and capital generation after credit losses deposit cost technology regulation capital claims and distributions
valuation_and_macro_boundary: price must assume normalized NIM losses deposit beta and market revenue; stress rates inflation unemployment liquidity and regulation
thesis_breaker: deposit cost and credit losses rise while loan growth or market revenue weakens and capital burden reduces common residual

promise_or_control_point: premium card spending merchant acceptance membership fees rewards and closed-loop data
immediate_payer_or_funder: card members merchants partners and borrowers
main_burden_carrier: rewards benefits funding credit losses merchant economics fraud service and acquisition
current_evidence: FY2025 revenue 72.2B; net income 10.8B; billed business 1.67T; net card fees 10B; 12.5M new cards; Q2 2026 US consumer spend up 11%
qoe_or_shenanigans_test: separate billed business discount revenue card fees rewards benefits funding delinquencies write-offs and retention
owner_cash_denominator: business and card economics after rewards benefits merchant costs funding credit losses acquisition service taxes and dilution
valuation_and_macro_boundary: price must assume premium retention and normalized credit; stress affordability rates rewards cost merchant pressure and travel/dining
thesis_breaker: spend or fees slow while rewards benefits credit losses or acquisition cost undermine network economics

promise_or_control_point: card and auto lending deposits and Discover payment-network expansion
immediate_payer_or_funder: card and auto borrowers depositors merchants and payment users
main_burden_carrier: charge-offs provisions reserve adequacy deposit cost integration rewards and capital
